answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy can leverage a Proof-of-Attestation protocol. Each agent's identity is cryptographically bound to a unique real-world identifier, attested by a network beacon. A verifiable digital quill records this attestation. To establish identity, agents must complete a unique zero-knowledge proof whose primitive root resembles the cryptographic hash of a 'yarrow' seed value. An attacker faces a quadratic cost in acquiring and processing these unique identifiers and proofs for each fake identity, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks infeasible.
